## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 453 captures during November 2024. This report provides a summary of activity, image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The activity figure should be used alongside the quality and grading measures below when reviewing the service’s performance.

## Image quality

A total of 86 captures were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 19.0 per cent of captures. The result indicates that image acquisition remains an area requiring attention. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk to support follow-up and resolution.

## Grading

Grading identified 101 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 6 days. These results should be considered with the image quality findings, as ungradable captures cannot contribute to a grading outcome.

The clinic lead has requested that camera problems continue to be recorded through the service desk. Maintaining a clear record of recurring issues will help support operational review and inform any required technical action.
